pages.words: CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING AGENDA Tuesday evening in the council chambers at City Hall. 1. Call to order and roll call of the members present. 2. Approval of the minutes of the previous meeting. 3. Public comment on items not on the agenda today. 4. Consent calendar items approved by a single vote. 5. Report from the finance director on the budget. 6. Resolution authorizing a contract for street repair. 7. Ordinance amending the zoning code for housing. 8. Council member reports and requests for future items. 9. Adjournment of the meeting until the next session.

pages.words: NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING ON THE PROPOSED BUDGET The planning commission will hear public testimony on the proposed budget for the coming fiscal year at seven o'clock on the second Thursday of the month. Copies of the proposal are available at the library, the senior center and the office of the city clerk. Residents may speak for three minutes or send a written statement to the clerk before noon on the day of the hearing today.
